hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean UI chrome with good typographic hierarchy and intentional muted palette, but the main visualization is cropped at the bottom edge of the card and the edge bundles are too dense to read individual connections.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is honest throughout: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node sizing and sunburst radial scale, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions present on all data joins, and no baseline violations since no bar/area channels are used.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire a full 1500ms flubber transition on every raw input event without debouncing or .interrupt(), creating update storms and mid-flight snap when the previous transition is abandoned without flushing current_x/y state; drag handlers also lack touch/mouse event filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout switching keeps working memory manageable, but 300 bundled edges over 200 nodes produces a visible hairball on the left cluster, the 8-button control strip plus 4 toggles adds interface overhead, and Flubber-driven morphing across 8 layout types is animation-heavy enough that perceptual congruence cannot be confirmed from a static screenshot.
